articles.title: After a Year of Blistering Growth, AI Chip Makers Get Ready for Bigger 2026
articles.mainIdea: After a Year of Blistering Growth, AI Chip Makers Get Ready for Bigger 2026
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: After a Year of Blistering Growth, AI Chip Makers Get Ready for Bigger 2026. Driven by the explosive growth of artificial intelligence, the largest semiconductor companies in the world recorded more than $400 billion in combined sales in 2025, by far the biggest year for chips on record. Hardware designers such as Nvidia which more than doubled its revenue year-over-year, are the main suppliers of the picks and shovels behind this new digital gold rush. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN, GOOG, NVDA.

articles.title: Silver Posts Biggest One-Day Decline in Nearly Five Years
articles.mainIdea: Silver Posts Biggest One-Day Decline in Nearly Five Years
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Silver Posts Biggest One-Day Decline in Nearly Five Years. Wild trading in metals markets Monday hit the brakes on a torrid year-end rally, sending silver futures to their steepest one-day decline in almost five years. The selloff in copper and precious-metals futures dragged down shares in Arizona mining firms, the world’s largest gold producer and a silver company with assets stretching from Alaska to Quebec. Key to electrical wiring running through data centers and power lines, copper fell 4.8%. Related tickers mentioned: DX-Y.NYB, GC=F, HG=F, SI=F.
